tasks.subject: Task 11: Worker header guard (X-TB-Key) — prod lockdown without a domain
tasks.description:
**Goal:** backend/src/index.ts rejects every request whose X-TB-Key header doesn't match the TB_SHARED_SECRET env var — active only when the secret is set (prod), zero behavior change when unset (dev). tbFetch (frontend/src/lib/server/tbFetch.ts:10-12) and the ETL client (etl/src/teenybase.ts:15-16) already send the header. Full code in plan doc Task 11 (wrap app.fetch in the default export — do NOT use Hono middleware; teenyHono registers routes internally).

**Files:** Modify backend/src/index.ts.

**Acceptance Criteria:** guard inert when TB_SHARED_SECRET unset (curl facilities list without header → 200); with secret set: missing/wrong X-TB-Key → 403 {"error":"Forbidden"} on ALL paths incl. sign-up and /api/v1/pocket/, correct header → 200; frontend works locally with the secret set on both sides (proves tbFetch passthrough); TB_SHARED_SECRET removed from backend/.dev.vars AND frontend/.env afterward; cd frontend && pnpm check 0/0.

**Verify:** curl triple (unset→200, guarded no/wrong header→403, correct header→200) + frontend proxy curl with secret set, outputs captured.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/src/index.ts"], "verifyCommand": "curl triple: unset->200, guarded no/wrong header->403, correct header->200; frontend /api/facilities 200 with secret set both sides", "acceptanceCriteria": ["guard inert when TB_SHARED_SECRET unset", "403 on missing/wrong X-TB-Key for all paths incl. sign-up and pocket UI", "200 with correct header", "frontend works via tbFetch with secret set", "dev env files restored"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
